art_instructions: In a cozy Greek classroom interior, place the owl (mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, small green scarf) seated on a low wooden chair at a child-height honey-colored oak desk near the front-center of the room. She sits upright with wings relaxed, the tips resting lightly on the desk edge, feet on a lower chair rung, head slightly tilted in a calm, attentive pose. Her tiny satchel hangs from the back of the chair; do not include other characters. Large windows on the left pour bright natural light across whitewashed walls with exposed wooden beams, casting soft sun rectangles onto the stone floor. A colorful woven rug with simple blue-and-yellow geometric patterns lies under the desk area. In the background, include a modest teacher’s podium with a small piece of blue-and-white pottery on it, and a few low grouped desks to suggest the classroom layout. Keep the focus on the idea “the owl sits at the desk”: any learning items on the desk (a small slate and reed stylus) should be present but closed and still.
